nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4.description: LLM Tech's sole hosted chat model (NVFP4-quantized Qwen3.8-27B on Blackwell), self-hosted on EU hardware (GPU node in Italy, edge in Nuremberg). Re-verified live via unauthenticated GET https://api.llmtech.eu/v1/models on 2026-09-28 (HTTP 200, exactly 1 model): context_length 262144, max_output/max_output_tokens 32768, pricing_per_m input $0.25 / output $2.09 / cache_read $0.04 per MTok, and a features array of [tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, logprobs, reasoning, vision] on the model object itself. All of this matches the vendor's own model page (https://llmtech.eu/models/qwen3.8-27b, retrieved 2026-09-28), which documents: an OpenAI-compatible client.chat.completions.create(...) quickstart against this baseURL; SSE streaming ('SSE, OpenAI format', stream=True in the sample); tool calling ('yes, with structured outputs'); real vision support ('yes, the vision tower is kept in BF16 and works' — image tokens count toward prompt_tokens and bill at the input rate, e.g. a 64x64 PNG costs 64 image tokens; images must go in a user message, not a system message; the page notes third-party listings calling this model text-only are wrong); reasoning control via enable_thinking/reasoning_effort request parameters; automatic prompt caching billed at the cache rate; and zero data retention (prompts/completions 'never used for training'). No response_format wire example or combined tools+response_format request is shown or was probed (see capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools). Not itself capability-probed end to end — credential-free onboarding, no API key used.

instructions: 1. LLM Tech publishes no public signup or self-service key page as of 2026-09-28 (self-service is described on the vendor's site as 'planned'); email artem@llmtech.eu to request a key — the account dashboard (https://llmtech.eu/cabinet/) confirms keys are issued by the company rather than self-created ('we hold no passwords and no accounts'; 'paste the API key we issued you')
2. Once you receive a key, https://llmtech.eu/cabinet/ shows current-month billing (totals, a daily usage chart, invoice line items) by pasting the key in — there is no separate account or login

3. Billing is pay-per-token USD with 'no subscription, no minimums' (input $0.25/M, output $2.09/M, cached input $0.04/M per https://llmtech.eu/models/qwen3.8-27b); no free tier is documented, so budget for paid usage from the first call
